attempts.text:
**The window starts in a five-column spine.** Columns 0 to 4, `ybbJ` to `copA`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and the model names 89 to 99.8% of them, fewest at `ybaT` in 89%. Hesitation is low, at most 0.44 bits at `cueR`.

**Column 5 is variable**, in a region of plasticity in 20% of calls, the most plastic stretch of the window. The model still names 94% there, with 0.24 bits.

**Then an 18-column spine**, `ybaP` to `mscK`, carried by 93 to 95% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 19% of calls. The model names 81 to 99%, fewest at `ybaK` in 81%, and hesitates most at `fsr`, 0.61 bits, the window's most hesitant column. Column 24, `acrR`, is variable.

**A long spine follows**, columns 25 to 68, `acrA` to `yajO`, carried by 91 to 95% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 7% of calls. The model names 94 to 99%, fewest at `yajR` in 94%, and hesitates most at `pdeB`, 0.49 bits. Across the window it names 97% of genes at 0.21 bits; inside a region of plasticity it names 68% against 98% outside, and hesitates 1.58 against 0.13 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 69 to 79 are carried by 47 to 89% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 2% of calls, and the model names 97 to 99%. Column 77 is a fork: `yajD` in 59%, with `espY3` in 12%. The last columns, `secF` and `secD`, [[protein translocation across the membrane]], close the window at 47%.

label: ybbJ
facts:
WINDOW: the ybbJ window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ybbJ, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,221 to 3,300 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ybbJ once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 97% of genes, 0.21 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 39,810 calls, named 99%, 0.12 bits; shell 2,988 calls, named 70%, 0.94 bits; cloud 322 calls, named 28%, 4.34 bits. Outside an RGP 40,887 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; inside an RGP 2,233 calls, named 68%, 1.58 bits. Columns: 67 spine, 1 fork, 12 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.58 against 0.13 bits) and names fewer genes (68% against 98%); 2,233 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 9 (fsr) 0.61 bits, RGP 17%; column 31 (pdeB) 0.49 bits, RGP 2%; column 60 (yajR) 0.47 bits, RGP 3%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 5 (variable), RGP 20%; the least: columns 69-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-4 (5 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-20%. Genes: ybbJ "NfeD family protein", cueR, ybaT "APC family permease", glsA, copA. named 89-99.8% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 2 (ybaT), named 89%; most hesitant at column 1 (cueR), 0.44 bits.
2. column 5 variable: RGP 20%. named 94%; 0.24 bits.
   5: ybaQ S 79% "HigA family addiction module antito…"
3. columns 6-23 (18 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 2-19%. Genes: ybaP "TraB/GumN family protein", ybaK "Cys-tRNA(Pro)/Cys-tRNA(Cys) deacyla…", ushA, fsr, ybaL "cation:proton antiporter", gsk, aes, hemH, adk, htpG, recR, ybaB "YbaB/EbfC family nucleoid-associate…", dnaX, apt, ybaN "DUF454 family protein", priC, rsmS, mscK. named 81-99% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 7 (ybaK), named 81%; most hesitant at column 9 (fsr), 0.61 bits.
4. column 24 variable: RGP 5%. named 95%; 0.37 bits.
   24: acrR P 90%
5. columns 25-68 (44 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 1-7%. Genes: acrA "multidrug efflux RND transporter pe…", acrB, tomB, hha, maa, ylaC "YlaC family protein", pdeB, ybaA "DUF1428 domain-containing protein", ybaZ "MGMT family protein", ybaY "YbaY family lipoprotein", tesB, amtB, glnK, mdlB "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", mdlA, decR, cof, ybaE "SgrR family transcriptional regulat…", queC, fadM, ybaV "helix-hairpin-helix domain-containi…", ppiD, hupB, lon, clpX, clpP "ATP-dependent Clp protease proteoly…", tig, bolA, yajG "lipoprotein", ampG, cyoA, cyoB, cyoC, cyoD "cytochrome o ubiquinol oxidase subu…", cyoE, yajR, yajQ "nucleotide binding protein YajQ", panE, yajL "DJ-1/PfpI family protein", thiI, xseB, ispA, dxs, yajO "aldo/keto reductase". named 94-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 60 (yajR), named 94%; most hesitant at column 31 (pdeB), 0.49 bits.
6. columns 69-79 (11 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 2%. named 97-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 78, named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.14 bits (column 69).
   columns 69-76 variable, share 65-89%, all P: pgpA 89%, thiL 87%, nusB 82%, ribH 78%, ribD "bifunctional diaminohydroxyphosphor…" 73%, nrdR 71%, yajI "DUF3251 domain-containing protein" 68%, tsx 65%
   77 fork: yajD P 59% "HNH nuclease YajD"; also espY3 S 12%
   78 variable: secF P 52% "protein translocase subunit SecF"
   79 variable: secD P 47%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): acrB efflux RND transporter permease AcrB; mdlA ATP-binding cassette domain-containing…; cyoA COX aromatic rich motif-containing prot…; cyoC cytochrome o ubiquinol oxidase subunit…; cyoE UbiA family prenyltransferase; ribH 6,7-dimethyl-8-ribityllumazine synthase; secF protein translocase subunit SecF; secD protein translocase subunit SecD; lapB ABC transporter transmembrane domain-co…; siiEA Ig-like domain-containing protein; espY3 pentapeptide repeat-containing protein
END: the window ends at column 79, secD, in 47% of chromosomes.
